name: DMNPC
effects: serotonin syndrome risk with serotonergic agents

mechanismOfAction.summary: Potent triple monoamine reuptake inhibitor (dopamine, norepinephrine and serotonin); ~2.5× cocaine potency at DAT. Piperidine-based phenyltropane/nocaine-related stimulant.
mechanismOfAction.description: Piperidine-based stimulant synthesized from arecoline. The 3S,4S enantiomer is most active; the 3R,4S enantiomer has the highest SERT selectivity. Acts by monoamine reuptake inhibition with no releasing-agent activity and no opioid receptor activity. No human pharmacological data. Significant serotonin syndrome risk in combination with MAOIs or other serotonergic agents.
